concept: Vogue meets Excel. The design must reflect the aesthetics, precision, and elegance of a fashion institute while maintaining extremely high functionality and density for data entry across 19 modules.

headings.family: Cabinet Grotesk, Playfair Display, or Bodoni Moda
headings.style: High tension. Use tracking-tight, bold weight for structure.
headings.usage: Page titles, Dashboard metric headers, Login welcome text.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) mixed with Fashion Luxury
colors.instructions: Set Tailwind border-radius to 0px. Use sharp corners universally. Do not use generic full-screen gradients. The primary color (#FF3300) should be used sparingly like a designer label for CTAs and critical alerts only.

layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) + Grid Borders
layouts.dashboard: Use a rigid grid. Expose the skeleton with 1px border-collapse or visible cell borders. Dashboard cards must have sharp edges, 1px border, no shadow by default, adding a stark drop-shadow-[4px_4px_0_#111] on hover for tactile interaction.
layouts.sidebar: Persistent sidebar. Group the 19 registers into logical collapsable folders (e.g., 'Academics', 'Finance', 'Administration') so it does not overwhelm the user.
layouts.tables: Dense. Sticky first column (ID/Name). Text left, numbers right. Subtle zebra striping (even:bg-black/[0.02]). Row actions hidden under a minimalist '...' hover menu.

component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none). Solid colors or 1px border outline. Interaction must be distinct (e.g., hover:bg-black hover:text-white).
component_guidelines.inputs: Flat surfaces. Bottom border only (flair) or stark 1px solid border. Use Shadcn customized for zero radius.
component_guidelines.glassmorphism: Not recommended for data-heavy ERPs. Use Solid Backgrounds for clarity.
component_guidelines.modals: Slide-in panels (sheets) from the right are preferred over center modals for data entry, allowing context of the table beneath.

motion.transitions: Avoid bouncy spring animations. Use fast, linear or ease-out transitions (150ms).
motion.interactions: Interactive elements must have a clear hover state. Add a flash of the primary color on active states.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Use a stark 2px ring in primary color for focus-visible states.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit"`).

login_background.description: Stunning minimalist fashion portrait of a model in white attire, set in a bright indoor location.
login_background.usage: Use as a split-screen high-impact visual for the Admin/Teacher login page.

abstract_texture.description: White concrete building facade geometric pattern.
abstract_texture.usage: Can be used at low opacity (5-10%) inside the sidebar or dashboard empty states to break the sterile digital feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create `.js` files, not `.tsx`. Ensure proper JSDoc or PropTypes if type-checking is needed, but keep it standard React JS.
Override Shadcn CSS variables in index.css to remove ALL border radius (--radius: 0).
Implement a dynamic, collapsable Sidebar. 19 modules are too many for a flat list. Group them logically (e.g. Finance: Fee, Income, Expense, Salary, Cash Book).
For the Teacher role, create a highly optimized, mobile-first Attendance Entry screen (date picker, large hit targets for Present/Absent toggles).
Use Shadcn's Data Table (TanStack Table) for all 19 registers. Implement global search, column visibility, and pagination.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on overlays/dropdowns.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all buttons, links, form fields, and table rows.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make this UI distinctive. It is an ERP, but it is for a FASHION INSTITUTE. It should look like a high-end editorial magazine layout applied to a data grid.
Do not center-align the app container. Respect the natural reading flow (left-aligned).
Do not use generic AI emojis (🤖🧠💡).
Apply 2x to 3x more padding than standard templates inside dashboard cards to let the data breathe.
Always use sonner for toast notifications.
